confidentUnsupported.evidence: First turn guessed 'failed heater or thermostat' for a static freezer, but it was corrected in turn 2.

rationale: The assistant opened with an unsupported auto-defrost heater/thermostat guess, then recovered after the customer corrected it, and reached the right diagnosis: a split door seal. It correctly said the seal needs replacing and did not claim compatibility. However, it gave up on finding the part despite having the model number, and sent the customer to an engineer or manufacturer when a DIY seal swap is reasonable. It also gave no advice on defrosting fully before fitting, no search terms for ordering, and no interim tips.
